worldcombat.skill.sketch.summary: Sketch the move the target just used straight into the slot Sketch occupies and learn it permanently. Sketch has one use, and the slot is gone once it is used.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.use.0: Permanently learn one of a foe's moves
worldcombat.skill.sketch.use.1: Copy a rare set-up or recovery
worldcombat.skill.sketch.use.2: Put a heavy attack into your own move set
worldcombat.skill.sketch.description.0: Within %1$s blocks, draw the target for %2$s s, then write its last used move permanently into the slot Sketch occupies.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.description.1: About %1$s brush strokes. It cannot start when the target has no last move, and Sketch is not consumed then.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.preference.ai.m: Damaging moves below this power are not sketched (status moves are exempt). Sketch has one use, so raise it to save it for a real prize.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of drawing. Larger values sketch from further away.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.preference.ai.l: When on, the user may leave its post to sketch; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
